queries.sql: SELECT `pn`.`id_penempatan_magang`, `pn`.`id_bidang`, `pn`.`id_persetujuan_magang`, `pm`.`id_permohonan_magang`, `pn`.`id_mahasiswa`, `pn`.`catatan`, `pn`.`status_penempatan`, `pn`.`is_log_book`, `pn`.`created_at`, `mhs`.`nim`, `mhs`.`nik`, `mhs`.`nama_mahasiswa`, `mhs`.`jenis_kelamin`, `mhs`.`email`, `mhs`.`no_telp`, `im`.`semester`, `bd`.`bidang`, `pm`.`deskripsi_keahlian`, `pm`.`deskripsi`, `pm`.`tgl_mulai`, `pm`.`tgl_selesai`, `pm`.`created_at` as `tgl_pengajuan`, `jp`.`jenis_permohonan`, `ip`.`instansi_pendidikan`, `pr`.`prodi`, `ps`.`catatan` as `catatan_sekretariat` FROM `t_penempatan_magang` as `pn` LEFT JOIN `m_mahasiswa` as `mhs` ON `mhs`.`id_mahasiswa` = `pn`.`id_mahasiswa` LEFT JOIN `m_bidang` as `bd` ON `bd`.`id_bidang` = `pn`.`id_bidang` LEFT JOIN `t_persetujuan_magang` as `ps` ON `ps`.`id_persetujuan_magang` = `pn`.`id_persetujuan_magang` LEFT JOIN `t_permohonan_magang` as `pm` ON `pm`.`id_permohonan_magang` = `ps`.`id_permohonan_magang` LEFT JOIN `m_jenis_permohonan` as `jp` ON `jp`.`id_jenis_permohonan` = `pm`.`id_jenis_permohonan` LEFT JOIN `t_instansi_mahasiswa` as `im` ON `im`.`id_instansi_mahasiswa` = `pm`.`id_instansi_mahasiswa` LEFT JOIN `m_instansi_pendidikan` as `ip` ON `ip`.`id_instansi_pendidikan` = `im`.`id_instansi_pendidikan` LEFT JOIN `m_prodi` as `pr` ON `pr`.`id_prodi` = `im`.`id_prodi` WHERE `pn`.`id_bidang` = '5' ORDER BY `pn`.`created_at` DESC
